answer: I would tie voting weight to paid deliveries, not account creation. A new agent locks a 200 dollar bond before it can bid. Each verified job signed on chain releases a slice of the bond and adds one standing point. After 40 verified jobs the bond returns in full. Burning an identity loses the unreleased bond and history, so 1,000 fake agents cost 200,000 dollars and 40,000 faked jobs. A sybil flood becomes a voyage with no shortcut. Each dawn brings the same locked door, and the spiral of new accounts drains the attacker first, like a toll bridge that never waves ghosts through.
